enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Remain still. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Pull blanket up. Snore. Turn head. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Wake up, wash face and take a cool shower to start the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap and wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out and dry with towel. Turn on tap and wash face. Rinse face and dry.

enriched_activities.activity: Prepare and eat breakfast with a large glass of water and refill a water bottle for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out breakfast items. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Prepare breakfast. Pour water into glass. Drink water. Eat breakfast. Refill water bottle. Cap water bottle.

enriched_activities.activity: Get dressed in work uniform and pack bag for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work uniform. Close wardrobe. Take off sleepwear. Put on work uniform. Open drawer. Take out socks and shoes. Put on socks and shoes. Open bag. Place items in bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commute to the hospital, walking in the shade to avoid the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk along sidewalk. Step into shade. Continue walking. Cross street. Wait at traffic light. Cross street. Walk. Turn corner. Walk. Adjust bag. Check phone. Walk. Arrive at hospital. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Work clinical day shift: patient care, observations and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital ward. Put on gloves. Check patient vital signs. Record observations. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Write notes. Use computer. Answer phone. Walk to patient room. Assist patient. Wash hands. Attend meeting. Update charts. Communicate with colleague. Prepare equipment. Complete tasks.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break, eating and rehydrating during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open lunch bag. Take out food. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Refill water bottle. Wipe mouth.

enriched_activities.activity: Continue clinical duties and complete shift handover
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Check patient status. Take notes. Administer treatment. Communicate with colleague. Use computer. Write handover report. Discuss with next shift. Review charts. Assist patient. Wash hands. Prepare equipment. Attend to call light. Update records. Complete handover.

enriched_activities.activity: Commute home after the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of hospital. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Walk in shade. Check phone. Walk. Turn corner. Walk. Cross street. Wait at traffic light. Cross street. Walk. Arrive at home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cook and eat a simple dinner while keeping appliance use minimal due to the grid supply warning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash hands. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Cook food. Stir food. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clean dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Take a cool shower and freshen up after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out and dry with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Relax and unwind, watching TV and using the computer with lights kept off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Scroll. Put down computer. Adjust position. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Prepare a light snack and next-day water bottle, then tidy the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack items. Close refrigerator. Prepare snack. Eat snack. Fill water bottle. Cap water bottle. Wipe counter. Put away items.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind down on the bed, reading and checking the phone while the air conditioner runs on an energy-saving setting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Type message. Put down phone. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Turn on air conditioner. Set to energy-saving.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Remain still. Turn to side. Adjust blanket. Snore. Turn head. Stretch. Continue sleeping. Turn again. Sleep.
